cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've authorized a final check of Mum's birthday invitations. What time did we settle on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seven is approved. You may read me the restaurant name exactly as you've written it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I approve you as proofreader. Read the booking confirmation aloud; I'll type from your version so no unauthorized spelling creeps in.

reason: Use approvals of time, wording and a proofreader role to cover A need to recover the booking details after B corrects the invitation responsibility.
